title: Rethinking Reasoning Paths as Phase-Structured Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2609.36461v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models often improve problem-solving performance by generating multi-step reasoning paths, yet how to analyze the hidden states along these paths remains unclear. Existing approaches typically assign each intermediate state the final-answer correctness label and train probes across heterogeneous questions. We argue that this protocol obscures reasoning dynamics in two ways: (1) correctness prediction can exploit question-level variation rather than path quality, and (2) states aligned by absolute step indices may correspond to different functional phases of reasoning. In this work, we propose to view reasoning paths as phase-structured trajectories within fixed questions. We instantiate this view as PAIR, short for Phase-Aligned Intra-question Reasoning. translated_title: 重新思考推理路径：将其视为相位结构化的轨迹
translated_abstract: 大语言模型通常通过生成多步推理路径来提升问题求解性能，然而如何分析这些路径上的隐藏状态仍不清楚。现有方法通常将最终答案的正确性标签赋予每个中间状态，并在异构的问题之间训练探测模型。我们认为这种实验协议在两个方面掩盖了推理动态：（1）正确性预测可能利用的是问题层面的差异而非路径质量；（2）按绝对步骤索引对齐的状态可能对应于推理的不同功能阶段。在本工作中，我们提出将推理路径视为固定问题内的相位结构化轨迹。我们将这一观点实例化为PAIR，即相位对齐的问题内推理（Phase-Aligned Intra-question Reasoning）。PAIR为每个问题采样多条轨迹，基于归一化的轨迹进度将可变长度的路径映射到共享的相对相位上，并对成功与失败的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将大语言模型的推理路径视为固定问题内的相位结构化轨迹，并构建PAIR框架，通过归一化进度将变长路径对齐到共享的相对相位，从而在问题内部对比成功与失败轨迹，更准确地刻画推理过程中的隐藏状态动态。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes viewing LLM reasoning paths as phase-structured trajectories within fixed questions and introduces PAIR (Phase-Aligned Intra-question Reasoning), which maps variable-length paths into shared relative phases to compare successful and failed trajectories for a clearer analysis of reasoning dynamics.
